title: Lethal Weapon
build: PAL disk release in a G64 image whose title program is the file LOADER (no file TITLE, which the game-over code asks for); three parts: the title and character select, the game at stage 1A played as Riggs, and the ending

credits.role: music (uncredited in the game; the composer confirmed it to the Video Game Music Preservation Foundation)

tools.emulator: release v3.14.0, v3.14.0-macos-arm64-gui.dmg (tools/vice-mcp); driven through kit/c64/vice.py; check-emulator 57 of 57
tools.publication: Python 3 and Node.js; symbols_export.py, listing.py; work/scripts/unpack.js runs the game's unpacker on the kit's 6502 for the Maps tab

accuracy.note: the music player: the page's driver held against the title's listing, which showed 64 bytes of the frequency tables missing from it
